proof_body:
by
  intro V _ _ h
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ : ∃ n, Fintype.card V = n + 3 := ⟨Fintype.card V - 3, by omega⟩
  let e : Fin (n + 3) ≃ V := (Fintype.equivFinOfCardEq hn).symm
  let f : SimpleGraph.cycleGraph (n + 3) →g (⊤ : SimpleGraph V) := ⟨e, fun {a b} hab => by
    have : a ≠ b := hab.ne
    simpa using e.injective.ne this⟩
  have hc : (SimpleGraph.cycleGraph.cycle n).IsHamiltonianCycle := by
    rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.isHamiltonianCycle_iff_isCycle_and_length_eq, SimpleGraph.cycleGraph.length_cycle, Fintype.card_fin]
    exact ⟨SimpleGraph.cycleGraph.isCycle_cycle, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨_, _, hc.map (f := f) e.bijective⟩
target_source: ∀ (V : Type*) [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V], 3 ≤ Fintype.card V → ∃ (a : V) (p : (⊤ : SimpleGraph V).Walk a a), p.IsHamiltonianCycle
